product.ta-alphatronic-p10-s.summary: The Alphatronic P10-S shipped with two diskette drives and MS-DOS 2.11.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10-s.history: Triumph-Adler documented the P10-S in August 1986 with replacement pages for the P10 manual. It was intended for office work with diskette-based programs.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10-s.technical.c: A hard disk expanded the workspace. The manual lists the external 20 MB Winchester drive and its controller as an option.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10-s.technical.v: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10-s.technical.l: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10-s.technical.s: Austauschseiten für Bedienhandbuch Alphatronic P10 nach P10-S · 08/1986
